The Blazor Web App is complete at `UniversityCourseCatalog/`. Here's what was built:

**Project structure:**
- `Models/Course.cs` — `Department`, `Course`, `Instructor`, `EnrollmentRequest` records/classes
- `Services/CatalogService.cs` — In-memory catalog with 18 courses across 6 departments, search/filter support
- `Components/Pages/Home.razor` — Featured courses cards + department links
- `Components/Pages/Courses.razor` — Searchable, filterable course table (by text + department dropdown)
- `Components/Pages/CourseDetail.razor` — Full course info with breadcrumbs, schedule, credits, instructor bio card
- `Components/Pages/Enroll.razor` — Standard HTML form (name, student ID, course select) with confirmation view

**Key design choices:**
- **Static SSR** (no SignalR/WebAssembly) — ideal for intranet with fast connectivity
- **No authentication** — open access as requested
- **Bootstrap** styling via the default template
- Form uses Blazor's `@formname`/`@onsubmit` SSR form handling with antiforgery protection
- Course preselection via query string (`/enroll?course=cs101`)

Run with: `cd UniversityCourseCatalog && dotnet run`
